transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23 Gemini pods had no Lore MCP tools for two reasons, one after the other. At first the subsystem only rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` for Claude, and gemini-cli has no MCP flag and reads its servers from settings, so Gemini pods got none. Subsystem v0.11.2 (lore #2133) tried to fix this by writing the servers to a system-scope settings file, `/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`, named by `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH`. gemini-cli refuses a system settings file unless its parent directory is root-owned, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed 'Security Warning: Skipping system settings file' and started with 'init … (0 tools)'. Subsystem v0.11.3 (subsystem #246, lore #2144) fixed it by merging the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`.

judgements.reason: The answer states that v0.11.2 wrote MCP servers to a system-scope settings file that gemini-cli refused because the pod runs as uid 1000, and that v0.11.3 fixed this by writing to /agent/.gemini/settings.json, matching the gold answer; the extra detail does not contradict it.
